A group of exiled '''heretics''' belonging to the [[Kissai]], the [[Priest/Legends|priest]] caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]],<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref><ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> settled the verdant<ref name="TEA" /> [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] of [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] in the years following<ref name="KOTORCGWE5" /> the [[27,700 BBY]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[invasion of Korriban]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

These outcasts were banished from the Sith homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TCSWE227">{{CSWECite|II|227|Korriban}}</ref> for interpreting the death of [[Sith King]] [[Adas]] during the invasion<ref name="END" /><ref name="BoS" /> as a sign from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to reject the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and embrace "the Unity", the idea that all [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life is [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and that no true opposites exist.<ref name="KOTORCGWE5" /> Fleeing [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] aboard a commandeered [[Rakatan ship]] equipped with a [[Force-drive|Force-powered hyperdrive]],<ref name="TEA" /> these Kissai<ref name="KOTORCGWE5" /> followed the Force<ref name="TEA" /> to the world of Tund<ref name="KOTORCGWE5" /> in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

The descendants of these heretics were eventually joined on Tund by a number of Sith-Human half-breed colonists from the Sith Worlds in the centuries following the founding of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in [[6900 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ignored Tund during the [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]] of the Sith Empire and Tund's population eventually gave rise to the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]] during the [[post-Manderon period]].<ref name="TEA" />
